header.title: PushStack
header.description: Stack-depth navigation for wizards, stepped modals, and page stacks. Increasing `index` pushes the new pane in from the cover edge while the current pane recedes; decreasing `index` pops. `mode`: `sync` / `wait` / `pop-layout`. `keepState` keeps inactive steps mounted. `pagination` and `swipe` are Swiper-style.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Next increments `index` (push). Back decrements it (pop). Incoming uses `enter`; outgoing uses `exit`.

copies.Account: Step 1. Next pushes this pane back and covers it from the end edge.
copies.Address: Step 2. Back pops the current pane off; Next pushes again.
copies.Review: Step 3. Back pops to Address — the buried pane scales forward.

axisY.title: axis y
axisY.description: `axis="y"` — push covers from the bottom; pop uncovers downward. Same `index` contract.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: Split `duration` and `easing`. Incoming uses enter; outgoing uses exit.

modeWait.title: mode wait
modeWait.description: `mode="wait"` — the outgoing pane finishes before the incoming step mounts.

modePopLayout.title: mode pop-layout
modePopLayout.description: `mode="pop-layout"` — outgoing is absolute; the host sizes to the incoming step.

texts.sibling: Sibling below — follows the active step height.

keepState.title: keepState
keepState.description: `keepState` preserves mounted steps. Type in the field, navigate away and back. `onViewChange` logs the identity swap.

direction.title: direction
direction.description: Named panes via `viewKey`. Without `index`, pass `direction` so Back pops instead of pushing.

paginationOverlay.title: Pagination overlay
paginationOverlay.description: `pagination.placement = "inside-end"` overlays the dots on the card, like Swiper.

copies.Account: Dots at the bottom, on top of the panel.

swipe.title: swipe
swipe.description: `swipe` — drag the card; the active pane follows the pointer and the neighbor peeks from the side (pass `views` so prev/next content is available). Commit past ~28% or flick; otherwise it settles back.

paginationTop.title: Pagination top
paginationTop.description: `inside-start` pins the dots to the top edge of the pane.

paginationColors.title: Pagination colors
paginationColors.description: Customize with `color`, `activeColor`, `size`, and `gap`. Also overridable via CSS `--gemst-push-stack-pagination-*`.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onViewChange` fires when the identity changes. `onPushStack` / `outPushStack` mark the start and end of stack motion.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled`, the active step snaps in with no stack motion.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, host styles merge onto the `section`. Pass `view` as the pane — the child is only the host.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Pass `utilities.css` helpers via `classNames`. This demo applies `gemst-relative` / `gemst-overflow-hidden` on `root` and `gemst-block` on `pane`.

header.title: PushStack API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `PushStack`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for axis, modes, direction, pagination, and swipe.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/push-stack` with its `push-stack.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. With asChild, the child is only the host — pass view / views as panes. The component handles the end of transform / opacity on each pane and then calls your handlers.

items.presence: This is stack navigation: the control that changes index / viewKey should reflect state. Do not convey information with the motion alone.
items.pagination: With onPagination, dots are buttons. Without it, they are decorative and swipe is ignored.
items.swipe: swipe needs onPagination and a count ≥ 2. Pass views so a neighbor can peek. Do not make swipe the only way to change steps.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce panes snap to the final state. The preference is read each render.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion. Only when motion is essential.
items.keepState: With keepState, inactive steps stay with display: none. They should not receive focus or be announced while hidden.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a host with the right semantics (section, div): that element is the stack container.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `display: grid`, `overflow: hidden`.
items.out: Pane in cover or recede depending on push/pop.
items.pop: Pop direction (outgoing covers; incoming advances from recede).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render from the current phase and swipe/pagination state.

items.cover: Distance of the covering pane. Default `100%`.
items.recede: Distance of the buried pane. Default `25%`.
items.depthScale: Scale of the buried pane. Default `0.96`.
items.depthOpacity: Opacity of the buried pane. Default `0.72`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Index, axis, cover/recede, pagination, and swipe.

events.title: Events
events.description: View change, pagination, and stack cycle.

items.children: Current step when `view` / `views` are omitted. Identity is `viewKey`, `index`, or the child’s `key`. With `asChild`, this is the host only.
items.view: Current pane when `asChild` is set (the child is only the host). Also used instead of `children`.
items.views: Full stack of panes. With `index`, the active pane is `views[index]` and neighbors can peek during swipe.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child. Pass `view` / `views` as panes.
items.index: Stack depth. Increasing pushes; decreasing pops. Used to infer `direction`.
items.viewKey: Stable identity for the current pane. Defaults to `index` when set.
items.direction: Force push or pop. When omitted, inferred from `index`. Without `index`, defaults to `push`.
items.axis: `x` (default) on the inline axis; `y` on the block axis.
items.mode: `sync` overlaps; `wait` finishes exit before enter; `pop-layout` makes outgoing absolute.
items.keepState: Keeps inactive steps mounted (`display: none`) so local state survives.
items.cover: How far the covering pane travels. Number → pixels; string → CSS. Default `100%`.
items.recede: How far the buried pane recedes. Default `25%`.
items.unmountOnExit: Skip stack motion and drop the outgoing pane.
items.pagination: Swiper-style dots. Number = count, or an object with `placement`, colors, `size`, `gap`.
items.swipe: `true` uses `axis` and the pagination count. Requires `onPagination` and count ≥ 2. Swipe toward start = next.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is incoming and `exit` is outgoing.
items.delay: Wait before each motion. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token, timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default enter `standard`, exit `exit`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the active pane with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onPagination: Dot pressed or swipe that commits a page. Update `index` / `viewKey` here.
items.onViewChange: After the active identity changes (skips the first mount).
items.onPushStack: When a push or pop starts playing.
items.outPushStack: When stack motion settles, motion is disabled, or the host unmounts.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-push-stack-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
